facts.fact: 维罗妮卡在自家公寓厨房擦干尼克手洗的最后一批银餐具，说尼克必须别再这么天真。
facts.anchor: said Veronica, drying the last of the silverware Nick had hand-washed in the kitchen sink in her apartment.

facts.fact: 尼克回应说他爱维罗妮卡。
维罗妮卡说总统将会是一位女性。
facts.anchor: The President is going to be a woman, and before you think.

facts.fact: 维罗妮卡被一名资深军官临时拉去参加总部会议；对方在去开会路上随口问起她的高跟鞋，让她警觉。
facts.anchor: She’d been pulled in on the spur of the moment by a senior officer who’d run into her in a hallway and struck up a conversation. His random question about her heels on the way to the meeting had put her on alert.

facts.fact: 会上简报人说，新通信系统将推广到整个中国特工网络——所有特工。
facts.anchor: We’re going to roll it out across the entire Chinese agent base — all of them.

facts.fact: 维罗妮卡在会上问，是否该出于隔离考虑给同一国家的多名特工配同样的系统。
facts.anchor: Are we sure we should provide the same system to multiple agents in the same country?

facts.fact: 维罗妮卡说他们可以在外面待二十年再回来，至少给自己一个在别处发挥作用的机会。
facts.anchor: At least we’ll have given ourselves the chance to be somewhere else for twenty years, where we might actually be able to play a role in protecting the country.

facts.fact: 维罗妮卡提议当晚做水疗之夜，说她还有盐磨砂膏，并问要不要穿高跟鞋。
facts.anchor: How about we do a spa night tonight? We haven’t had one in a bit. I still have some of that salt rub stuff left. Want me to put on heels?
